profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Solutions Architect | AWS, Azure, .NET, C#, Terraform
profile.summary:
Experienced Principal Software Engineer with expertise in AWS cloud architecture, serverless systems, and technical leadership. Proven track record of modernizing legacy applications, establishing architectural standards, and mentoring development teams through complex technical transformations.

Skills Summary
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, API Gateway, IAM, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, S3), Azure, Terraform, Serverless Architecture, Event-Driven Systems, Microservices
• Programming & Frameworks: C#, .NET 8, MediatR, CQRS, Vertical Slice Architecture, ASP.NET, Entity Framework
• Data & Integration: Kafka Event Source Mapping, SQL Server, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, OpenTelemetry, REST APIs
• DevOps & Tools: CircleCI, GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus, Azure DevOps, Git/GitHub
• Authentication & Security: Okta, Auth0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, IAM

positions.title: Digital Engineering & AI Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Idaho Falls, Idaho, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Healthcare solutions company providing digital hub services for patient specialty therapies

• Principal Software Engineer on a multi-team initiative that successfully delivered a distributed digital hub integrating insurance, patient, practice, and pharmaceutical data within 6 months, achieving 14K+ concurrent users, 787K+ patient profiles, and ~9 million patient service records.
• Architected comprehensive AWS Lambda optimization strategy including provisioned concurrency, memory tuning, and batch/poll configurations, eliminating cold start issues and reducing average response times ~98.4% across critical services
• Designed and implemented enterprise-wide resiliency patterns using Polly for external service calls, reducing daily failure occurrences from 4-10 per service to zero across OpenSearch and Auth0 integrations
• Resolved critical production scalability constraint by engineering permanent solution for Lambda code storage limits, reducing usage from 99% to 10% and preventing service deployment failures
• Created Lambda Event Source Mapping architecture for 55 Lambda consumers, providing reusable patterns adopted across teams
• Established idempotency framework leveraging Kafka consumer group offsets, eliminating duplicate processing issues and ensuring reliable event-driven architecture across distributed services
• Provisioned Auth0 tenants, OAuth clients, and authorization backends using Terraform with custom domains and token enrichment currently supporting 14K+ concurrent users
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · Terraform · Kafka · CircleCI · Auth0

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software platform specializing in education industry simulation-based learning

• Enhanced team capabilities through mentoring on microservice architecture, Azure, .NET, and unit testing best practices
• Established architectural standards for next-generation Learning Studio software, documented in Confluence and Lucidchart
• Developed distributed tracing project using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, and Azure services to enhance monitoring and observability
positions.insights: Skills: Azure · .NET · Software Design · Microsoft Azure · Datadog · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Solutions Architect
positions.locationName: Idaho Falls, Idaho, United States · Remote
positions.description:
RV Dealer with nationwide locations building technical portfolio

• Created full AWS environment using Terraform for AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, VPC/Subnets, and IAM in multi-account structure following AWS best practices
• Delivered AWS infrastructure projects using Terraform and C# .NET 6 Lambdas while establishing standardized deployment processes
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, TeamCity, and Octopus for microservices and AWS deployment
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · C# · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Core · REST APIs · Okta

positions.title: Solutions Architect / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Document creation, generation, delivery, and eSign technology for mortgage industry

• Led development of scalable microservices architecture supporting large client base while championing DevOps practices across teams
• Designed user management application with Okta abstraction, attribute-based access control (Casbin.Net), AWS Lambda token enrichment, and Terraform-managed OAuth infrastructure.
• Engineered transactional email microservice handling 8-10 million emails monthly using AWS Lambdas, SQS, SNS, and Postmark
• Built automated CI/CD pipelines with TeamCity and Octopus Deploy for continuous integration and release management
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · C# · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Core · REST APIs · Okta

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Global ethics compliance and risk mitigation software company

• Led team in architecture and implementation of new RiskRate REST API
• Optimized core website component load times from 40-60 seconds to 2-4 seconds, preventing contract cancellations
• Improved grid performance to milliseconds for multi-million record datasets through star schema data warehouse implementation
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft SQL Server · AngularJS · Entity Framework (EF) Core · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wholesale distributor of vehicle performance parts

• Architected and refactored REST API in AWS environment, now serving as primary source for business operations
• Secured REST API with JWT token authentication and migrated business logic from stored procedures to C# with Entity Framework
positions.insights: Skills: C# · AngularJS · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Largest private university in Idaho

• Delivered full-stack development using C#, REST Web Services, ASP.NET, AngularJS for multiple departments
• Replaced third-party vendor application with custom solution, reducing PCI DSS scope through CyberSource integration
positions.insights: Skills: C# · AngularJS · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · REST APIs · Entity Framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Property management software solutions provider

• Optimized web application performance from seconds to milliseconds through EntityFramework and LINQ optimization
• Created ASP.NET MVC website for mass texting campaigns using Twilio SMS gateway with scheduling and conversation tracking
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Microsoft SQL Server · Twilio · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Global provider of commercial nuclear power tools and process improvements

•	Created and reviewed software requirements (IEEE standards) for Plant Process Computer (PPC) Systems
•	Designed several components of a PPC for extracting and calculating data using C++ and TCP/IP protocols
•	Prepared for future enhancements by creating software demonstrating shared memory usage between a managed code application (C#) and an unmanaged code application (C++)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software and IT service company for the medical and agricultural industries

•	Created a livestock management system, providing analysis tools, and tracking health data and movements via radio frequency (RF) tags on individual animals.  Assisted Electrical Engineer on transceiver specifications, firmware issues, and system design
•	Improved system compatibility by creating an USB to RF transceiver interface using Platform Invoke calls
•	Increased RF tag read speed from once per second to several hundred per second through multi-threading
•	Recovered $30K in quarterly missing charges for a small hospital through ASP.NET data scrubbing system

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Leading computer forensics company specializing in software for law enforcement agencies

•	Assisted in the design and creation of the latest version of Forensic Toolkit, a popular computer forensics tool used by law enforcement agencies worldwide.  
•	Designed and implemented a flexible user interface allowing users to quickly and accurately search digital evidence in C++/MFC
•	Added flexibility and power to forensic reports by implementing XML output with XSL style-sheets, also allowing for user defined XSLT and XSL-FO

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software and IT service company for the medical and agricultural industries

•	Design and develop medical software applications for portable devices. Collaborate with engineer team on new projects, proposed enhancements, and problem resolutions
•	Increased product reliability by creating core component used to marshal data 
•	Decreased development time by assisting in creation of C++ objects using OOP concepts
